title: Establishing and Evaluating Trustworthy AI: Overview and Research Challenges
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion/faith. Its focus is a general overview of the principles and challenges of trustworthy AI, such as fairness, transparency, and accountability, without using religion as an example or case study.
